overview: This short House resolution allows official photographs of the House of Representatives to be taken while the House is actually in session, on a date chosen by the Speaker of the House. Normally House rules restrict photography on the House floor during proceedings. The resolution also allows the costs of taking, preparing, and distributing the photos to be paid from House accounts. The House adopted it on June 4, 2025.
for: Supporters say it allows a historical record of the full House at work, at no disruption to normal business beyond a single day chosen by the Speaker.
against: Critics say the resolution is routine and has little effect beyond a one-time exception to House photography rules, with costs paid from House funds.
